title: My Music Staff Alternatives: 8 Options Compared (2026)
description: My Music Staff alternatives compared on published prices: MakeMusic Studio, Duet, mySymphony, Trio, Nova Music, Studio Helper, Teach 'n Go and TutorTally.
h1: My Music Staff alternatives for music teachers and studios
body:
My Music Staff is $16.95/mo for you plus $4.95/mo for each additional teacher or staff member, with unlimited students, SMS reminders, a student portal and a website builder included. It offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card, a 90-day money-back guarantee and no contracts (My Music Staff pricing, checked 2026-11-12). That's already one of the lower prices in music lesson software, so the usual reasons to look elsewhere are a free plan for a small studio, a flat price for a growing team, or a different payment setup. Here is what the main alternatives publish.

We checked each vendor's own public pricing page on November 12, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything not published is marked unknown. We haven't used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:my-music-staff,fons,duet,mysymphony,trio,nova-music,studio-helper,teach-n-go,tutortally}}

Monthly cost by studio size (list prices)

Worked out from each vendor's published prices, in USD per month before payment processing, counting every teacher including you. "Solo" assumes one teacher with weekly lessons, so mySymphony Solo hits its $20/mo cap at 80 booked lessons a month.

ToolSolo, 20 studentsSolo, 60 students3 teachers, 60 students5 teachers, 100 students
My Music Staff ($16.95 + $4.95/extra teacher)$16.95$16.95$26.85$36.75
MakeMusic Studio ($19.95 + $4.95/extra teacher)$19.95$19.95$29.85$39.75
Duet ($9 flat)$9$9$9 (multi-teacher support not stated)$9 (multi-teacher support not stated)
mySymphony (Solo $0.25/lesson, cap $20; Ensemble $15 + $5/extra teacher)$20 (Solo)$20 (Solo)$25 (Ensemble)$35 (Ensemble)
Trio (Free up to 10 students; Pro $5 + $5/extra seat)$5 (Pro)$5 (Pro)$15 (Pro)$25 (Pro)
Nova Music (Free up to 10 students; Pro $10)$10 (Pro)$10 (Pro)n/a (multi-teacher plan "coming soon")n/a
Studio Helper ($50 + $0.25/student)$55$65$65$75
Teach 'n Go (up to 100 live students)$79$79$79$79
TutorTally ($9.99/mo or $99.99 once)$9.99$9.99n/a (single-teacher app)n/a

Payment fees are on top and differ a lot: MakeMusic Studio publishes 2.9% + $0.30 per card charge, 1.8% per ACH charge and 0.4% of subscription volume; Duet families pay a 1% Duet fee plus 2.9% card processing (ACH has no card fee); TutorTally never handles money at all. The others don't publish their processing rates.

The alternatives

  • MakeMusic Studio (formerly Fons): the closest like-for-like switch. $19.95/mo plus $4.95/mo per additional teacher or admin staff, unlimited students and appointments, no minimum term, 14-day free trial. It is the only tool here that publishes its full card, ACH and subscription fee schedule. {{aff:fons|Visit MakeMusic Studio}}
  • Duet: the lowest flat subscription we found, $9/mo or $99/yr, all features, "flat rate, regardless of studio size", 30-day free trial. Families pay a 1% transaction fee on statements. Some promotions on its pricing page date from 2024, so confirm current features on a call. {{aff:duet|Visit Duet}}
  • mySymphony: pay-as-you-teach. Solo is $0.25 per booked lesson, capped at $20/mo, for one teacher with up to 100 active students and 50 SMS a month. Ensemble is $15/mo for the first teacher plus $5 per added teacher (up to 50, then $3), with unlimited students and locations. 30-day free trial, no card. {{aff:mysymphony|Visit mySymphony}}
  • Trio: free forever for up to 10 active students with scheduling, invoices and a parent portal (cash and check payments only on Free). Pro is $5/mo or $50/yr with no student limit and online payments via Stripe; each additional seat is $5/mo. Max ($20/mo) adds rooms and more than one location. {{aff:trio|Visit Trio}}
  • Nova Music: free for up to 10 students; Pro is $10/mo or $100/yr with unlimited students, calendar sync and auto-invoicing. A multi-teacher Studio plan is listed as coming soon, so today it fits solo teachers. {{aff:novamusic|Visit Nova Music}}
  • Studio Helper: $50/mo plus $0.25 per student, one plan with every feature, 30-day free trial. It costs more than My Music Staff at every size above, but it is built for multi-teacher studios and lists room scheduling, payroll, expense and inventory tracking. See Studio Helper vs My Music Staff for the head-to-head. {{aff:studio-helper|Visit Studio Helper}}
  • Teach 'n Go: for music schools rather than private teachers. $79/mo for up to 100 live students with 3 admin users, unlimited teachers and student, parent and teacher portals ($99 for 200, $129 for 300); Pro is $109/mo with unlimited admins and locations. Annual billing gets two months free. 14-day free trial, 30-day money-back guarantee. {{aff:teachngo|Visit Teach 'n Go}}
  • TutorTally: an offline app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Free for 2 students, then $9.99/mo, $49.99/yr or $99.99 once for a lifetime license. No accounts and no payment processing: families pay you directly. {{aff:tutortally|Visit TutorTally}}

Which one fits

  • Under 10 students: Trio and Nova Music both have free plans for up to 10 students; TutorTally is free for 2.
  • Solo teacher, lowest price: Trio Pro ($5/mo), Duet ($9/mo), TutorTally ($9.99/mo or $99.99 once) and Nova Music Pro ($10/mo) all list less than My Music Staff's $16.95.
  • Multi-teacher studio: Trio Pro and mySymphony Ensemble charge less per added teacher than My Music Staff on list price ($5 vs $4.95 per seat, but lower base prices). Teach 'n Go includes unlimited teachers and prices by student count instead.
  • Known payment fees: MakeMusic Studio and Duet publish their fees; the rest don't.

Before you switch

My Music Staff has no contracts, so you can leave any time, but plan the move: export your student list, lesson history and any invoices first, and ask the new vendor how it imports them. If families pay by stored card through Stripe or PayPal, ask whether those payment methods can be moved or whether families will need to re-enter them. Most tools here offer a free trial or free plan, so run one month of real lessons in parallel before cancelling. Our software buying checklist covers what to ask on a demo.

faq: How much does My Music Staff cost?

$16.95/mo for one teacher plus $4.95/mo for each additional teacher or staff member, with unlimited students. It has a 30-day free trial with no credit card, a 90-day money-back guarantee and no contracts (mymusicstaff.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-12).
Is there a free alternative to My Music Staff?

Yes. Trio is free forever for up to 10 active students (cash and check payments only on Free), Nova Music is free for up to 10 students and TutorTally is free for 2 students (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-11-12).
What is the cheapest My Music Staff alternative?

Among paid plans we list, Trio Pro is $5/mo or $50/yr with no student limit, Duet is $9/mo or $99/yr flat, TutorTally is $9.99/mo or $99.99 once, and Nova Music Pro is $10/mo (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-11-12).

Fons is now MakeMusic Studio. It lists $19.95/mo plus $4.95/mo per additional teacher or admin staff, unlimited students, a 14-day free trial and published fees of 2.9% + $0.30 per card charge and 1.8% per ACH charge (studio.makemusic.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-12).
Which My Music Staff alternative is best for a music school with many teachers?

Teach 'n Go includes unlimited teachers from $79/mo for up to 100 live students; mySymphony Ensemble is $15/mo plus $5 per added teacher with unlimited students; Studio Helper is $50/mo plus $0.25 per student (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-11-12).
